name: Table
description: Mortar plain semantic table for documents and summaries without row actions.

props.caption: string
props.columns: { key: string; label: string; align?: left | right }[]

contract.usage: Import { Table } from @tony-ui/mortar. Pass groups to render each labelled group as its own tbody under a full-width header row (th scope=rowgroup); ungrouped rows render first. Use DataTable instead when rows need selection, sorting, links or loading states.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
